title: Bundle EXTRA for Decentralized Optimization
summary: Decentralized primal-dual methods are widely used for solving decentralized optimization problems, but their updates often rely on the potentially crude first-order Taylor approximations of the objective functions, which can limit convergence speed. To overcome this, we replace the first-order Taylor approximation in the primal update of EXTRA, which can be interpreted as a primal-dual method, with a more accurate multi-cut bundle model, resulting in a fully decentralized bundle EXTRA method. The bundle model incorporates historical information to improve the approximation accuracy,…
